/cancel-solar-contract/henderson-nv.question: Can I cancel a solar contract in Henderson, Nevada?
/cancel-solar-contract/henderson-nv.answer: Possibly, but cancellation is never automatic. Nevada gives a purchaser, lessee or power-purchase-agreement customer three business days to cancel by written notice, and ten business days if the borrower was 60 or older when they signed. Outside that window, the strongest documented angle is usually licence status: if the installer was unlicensed or acting beyond its licence limit when you signed, the agreement is voidable for three years. That turns on the public licence record, not proof that anyone lied.
/cancel-solar-contract/henderson-nv.localNote: Henderson sits in Clark County, where about 11,091 homes hold a permit from an installer that has since failed. Nevada complaints against solar companies go to the State Contractors Board, which runs a Solar Investigations Unit; the Attorney General accepts consumer complaints separately. Filing either one creates a record but does not itself cancel an agreement or pause payments.
